pages.text: The $(item)Neko Energy Battery$() is the $(#FF69B4)portable energy core$() of the neko world. Just keep it in your inventory — it works automatically! When you're low on energy, it $(thing)auto-discharges$() to refill you. When your energy overflows, it $(thing)auto-absorbs$() the excess.$(br2)It's like carrying a power bank and energy recycler in one!$(br2)There's also a $(item)Large Neko Energy Battery$() upgrade version~

pages.title: Auto-Discharge
pages.text: When your $(thing)Neko Energy$() is below max, the battery automatically transfers stored energy to you every second:$(br2)$(li)Fixed discharge rate per second — won't drain all at once$(li)Multiple batteries $(#FF69B4)discharge in sequence$()$(li)Stops automatically when you're full$(br2)This gives your energy bar a safety net during adventures — it won't hit zero as easily!

pages.title: Auto-Charge
pages.text: Conversely, when your $(thing)Neko Energy$() is full and would overflow from natural regeneration, the battery automatically absorbs the excess:$(br2)$(li)Overflow energy $(#FF69B4)flows into the battery$() instead of being wasted$(li)Multiple batteries $(#FF69B4)charge in sequence$()$(li)If all batteries are full, excess energy is lost$(br2)Never worry about wasting natural energy regen again!

pages.title: Status Display
pages.text: Like vanilla tools, the battery has a $(#FF69B4)durability bar$() showing its charge level:$(br2)$(li)$(#55FF55)Green$()（>70% charge）— Full of power!$(li)$(#FFFF55)Yellow$()（30%–70% charge）— Still got some juice$(li)$(#5555FF)Red$()（<30% charge）— Needs charging!$(br2)Hover over it to see the exact stored energy value and charge/discharge rates.

pages.title: Vs. Energy Storage Devices
pages.text: How is this different from $(item)Energy Storage Devices$()?$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Energy Storage Devices$()：Manually charge/discharge in the aggregator — like a rechargeable battery, requires active operation$(li)$(thing)Neko Energy Battery$()：$(#FF69B4)Fully automatic$() charge/discharge — just leave it in your bag, like a power bank$(br2)Recommended to use both: storage devices for bulk capacity, batteries for daily buffering. The perfect energy management system, meow!
